Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Podracer Bay]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinepodracerbay-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinepodracerbay.jpg tatooinepodracerbay.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010829200039/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinepodracerbay.jpg Internet Archive], 29 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: c98f58204eb32c9bcd8a27d6f404b28f281aa1d54edbaab4491d006b44158e7f.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 90 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (4 pixel rows of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinepodracerbay.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.
